name: SiteFix
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
SiteFix is the ultimate WordPress accessibility plugin that automatically audits and fixes your site to meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards, supercharging your Lighthouse accessibility scores without any hassle. This lightweight, backend-only tool delivers pure server-side patches and intelligent JavaScript—no bulky widgets or disruptive layout shifts.

Why Choose SiteFix?

  • Instant Lighthouse Boost: Gain 10-20+ points in accessibility audits effortlessly.
  • Universal Compatibility: Seamless with Gutenberg blocks, Elementor widgets, and any theme—handles dynamic content via MutationObserver.
  • Zero Configuration: Enable fixes in the dashboard; they apply site-wide on the fly.

Free Features (4 Universal Fixes):

  • Alt Text Injection: Auto-generates descriptive alt attributes from image filenames for screen reader support.
  • Heading Hierarchy Enforcer: Logical H1-H6 structure via regex & JS—no skips or jumps.
  • Focus & Skip Links: Visible outlines for keyboard nav + hidden skip-to-content link.
  • Link Name Enhancer: ARIA labels for empty links, ensuring discernible names.

Perfect for SEO too—accessible sites rank higher and reduce bounce rates!

Upgrade to Pro for advanced tools like contrast boosts, AI alt text, full ARIA roles, and a compliance statement: Get SiteFix Pro Now ($39 lifetime).

“SiteFix transformed our site’s accessibility overnight—Lighthouse jumped from 65 to 95!” – Happy User

Ready to make your WordPress site inclusive? Install now and audit your fixes today!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sitefix/.
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu.
  3. Head to SiteFix > Dashboard to run your first audit and enable fixes.
sections.faq:
How does SiteFix boost my Lighthouse score?

By automatically applying WCAG-compliant fixes to common issues like missing alt text and poor focus indicators. Expect 10-20+ point gains—test it yourself!

Is it compatible with Gutenberg and Elementor?

Yes! Universal server-side filters + JS handle static and dynamic content flawlessly.

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

Free: 4 core fixes. Pro: Adds contrast enhancement, AI alt text, unlimited audits, and a printable compliance report. Upgrade here.

Does it cause layout shifts or slow my site?

No—runtime-only patches with zero bloat. Optimized for speed and SEO.

Legal protection against lawsuits?

We enhance accessibility, but we’re not lawyers. Consult a pro for compliance advice.
